title: Canonical residue fibre of the normal cone and initial classes
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring, let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal, and put $A=R/I$ and $k=R/\mathfrak m$. Give $k$ its canonical $A$-algebra structure via the quotient factor map $R/I\to R/\mathfrak m$, $r+I\mapsto r+\mathfrak m$. Let $G=\operatorname{gr}_I R=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}I^n/I^{n+1}$ with its degree-zero $A$-algebra structure and homogeneous inclusions $\iota_n$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Define the normal-cone residue fibre to be the commutative $k$-algebra $F=k\otimes_A G$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with tensor-product multiplication and $k$-algebra map $c\mapsto c\otimes1$. For $n\geq0$ and $a\in I^n$, define its residue-fibre initial class as $1\otimes\iota_n(a\bmod I^{n+1})\in F$. No Noetherianity, flatness, reducedness or characteristic hypothesis is required.
